facts.fact: Eswatini's justice minister received UNDP equipment worth USD 10,000 to accelerate the rollout of the Integrated Electronic Case Management System, which links the judiciary with police, prosecution and correctional services.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs
Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs

SWZ.note: The equipment is for the police and correctional services to implement the IECMS rollout, but no station records, stations or pilot are stated.
